en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a flock of Merino sheep eating in a farmyard. On the left stands a young man in work clothes beside a stone wall; in the doorway of a building on the right stands an older man with a beard and hat, holding a cane or stick. Printed red German text at the bottom identifies the Merino stud sheep farm in Leutewitz near Meissen, Kingdom of Saxony, and the owner. A red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.
